title: Vandermonde field equivalence
statement: Let $\ell\in\mathbb N$, and let $f(X)=X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$ be an irreducible polynomial over $\mathbb F_2$, with each $a_i\in\mathbb F_2$. Then the field obtained by adjoining a root of $f$ is isomorphic to the degree-$\ell$ extension field of $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: The polynomial $f(X)=X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$ is irreducible over $\mathbb F_2$
